candidates.change_summary: Change Acc[msg.sender].unlockTime assignment to always set unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime (no clamp to block.timestamp).
Set unlockTime to block.timestamp + _unlockTime (treat argument as duration rather than absolute time).
Do not update acc.unlockTime at all (remove the assignment), leaving previous unlockTime unchanged.
Always set unlockTime to block.timestamp (ignoring input), making funds immediately withdrawable after Put.
Set unlockTime to the maximum of current acc.unlockTime and provided _unlockTime (only extend lock, never shorten).
Replace the condition block so Collect requires block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime (allows collect at equal timestamp) instead of strictly greater, changing when funds become withdrawable.
Change transfer attempt to use send pattern by replacing call with (bool _s) = payable(msg.sender).send(_am), altering reentrancy and failure behavior.
Move the balance subtraction to after the external call (send funds first, then update state), creating a change in observable behavior and reentrancy susceptibility.
Remove the MinSum check from the conditional, allowing collects even when balance < MinSum and thus changing when withdrawals are permitted.
